text: Give each variable a clear name so the next reader can understand its purpose without opening another file.
A function should receive explicit input, perform one understandable task, and return a predictable result.
Run the test suite before committing a change, even when the edit appears too small to cause trouble.
The boolean value true is different from the string value that contains the four letters t, r, u, and e.
Comments are most useful when they explain why a decision was made instead of repeating the code.
An empty array still has a length of zero and can safely be passed to a well-designed loop.
Save your work often, keep commits focused, and describe each change with a meaningful message.
A useful error message tells the user what failed and suggests a practical way to recover.
The loop visits every item once, adds valid values to the total, and ignores missing entries.
Use const when a JavaScript binding will not be assigned a different value later in the same scope.
The command git status shows which files changed without modifying the working directory.
Small modules are easier to test when their dependencies arrive through parameters rather than global state.
A null value usually means that a value is intentionally absent, while undefined often means it was never supplied.
The README should explain how to install the project, run it locally, and report a reproducible problem.
Before deleting unused code, search the entire repository for imports, calls, and documentation references.
A cache improves speed only when its invalidation rules are simpler than repeating the original computation.
Keep secret tokens outside source control and load them from a protected environment at runtime.
The expression items.filter(isValid) creates a new array and leaves the original collection unchanged.
When an API returns HTTP 404, distinguish a missing resource from a temporary network failure.
A database transaction keeps related writes together, allowing every change to succeed or the whole operation to roll back.
Normalize user input at a clearly defined boundary, but preserve the original value when an exact record matters.
The selector .toolbar > button targets direct child buttons without matching controls nested in another container.
Use npm test -- --watch during development, then run the complete noninteractive suite before release.
The map operation transforms every element, whereas reduce combines a sequence into one accumulated value.
An accessible button needs a clear label, visible focus feedback, and reliable keyboard activation.
If parseInt receives untrusted text, validate the entire result and specify the expected numeric base.
A retry policy needs a maximum attempt count, exponential delay, and random jitter between requests.
The path /var/log/app.log is absolute, while logs/app.log is interpreted relative to the current directory.
Feature flags separate deployment from release, but abandoned flags eventually become confusing branches.
A semantic version such as 2.4.1 communicates major, minor, and patch compatibility expectations.
Check array boundaries before reading values[index], especially when index can originate from user input.
The query parameter ?page=3 belongs after the path and before any fragment beginning with a hash sign.
Structured logs make fields such as requestId, durationMs, and status searchable without parsing prose.
Prefer an immutable copy when several components might otherwise mutate the same object unexpectedly.
The regular expression /^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{2,31}$/ accepts a lowercase identifier with controlled punctuation and length.
Serialize the payload with JSON.stringify(data), set Content-Type: application/json, and handle non-2xx responses explicitly.
A race condition appears when correctness depends on unpredictable timing between concurrent operations.
Parameterize SQL queries instead of concatenating untrusted strings, because escaping rules vary by database and context.
The shell pipeline rg --files | sort lists repository paths efficiently, but it does not inspect their contents.
Memoization exchanges memory for time by caching outputs under keys derived from deterministic function arguments.
Represent state transitions explicitly so loading, success, empty, and failure cannot become contradictory at runtime.
A Unicode grapheme may contain several code points, so text.length is not always the number of visible characters.
Use AbortController to cancel obsolete fetch requests when a newer search makes their eventual responses irrelevant.
Idempotent handlers allow a repeated request with the same key to return safely without duplicating side effects.
The CSS declaration grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); creates three equal, shrinkable tracks.
Collect latency percentiles rather than relying only on averages, which can conceal a small group of extremely slow requests.
A migration should move the schema forward, preserve existing records, and either support rollback or document why it cannot.
Validate redirect targets against an allowlist; accepting an arbitrary next=https://example.net value creates an open redirect.
Property-based tests generate many inputs to discover invariants that a handful of carefully chosen examples might overlook.
When profiling reveals allocation pressure, inspect object lifetimes before introducing a complicated reusable buffer pool.
